scope: Reviewed disposition of the268 normalized main-text difference regions, with semantic exclusions retained. This does not establish whole-source admission, publisher-byte authenticity or semantic compilation.

dispositions.optional-parameters: Default slot and source-local mode/order/owner restrictions are implemented; constantness, value type identity, conversion and warning effects remain excluded.
dispositions.named-arguments: Colon arguments, index ref/out exclusion, constructor attribute labels and local ordering/duplicate-name checks are implemented. Parameter/member lookup, overloads, array target identity and evaluation remain excluded.
dispositions.variance: Interface/delegate annotation grammar and owner checks are implemented. Variance safety, conversion, inference and interface implementation remain excluded semantic work.
dispositions.generic-followers: The guarded fourth follower module implements single | and ^; predecessor follower tables stay unchanged.
dispositions.base-projections: The fourth expression policy admits selected base members, retaining an inferred member identifier; arbitrary expressions and base indexes remain excluded categories.
dispositions.transcription-normalization: Lexical spelling, optional suffix, relocated expression-list, missing heading colons and fixed-buffer comma/constant-expression names map to existing normalized syntax.
dispositions.unicode-continuity: UAX reference clarification does not replace the explicitly approved frozen Unicode4 scalar contract.
dispositions.contextual-name-binding: Identifier spelling remains syntax; choosing a declared var type versus inference requires binding.
dispositions.documentation-trivia: Documentation-comment XML/tag content remains comment trivia; no documentation compiler is claimed.
dispositions.retained-semantic-or-editorial-boundary: Inspected difference adds no normalized token/owner category: spelling/reference/table/example edits or changes to binding, declaration spaces, type/variable identity, accessibility, conversions, inference, value/control-flow/runtime/compiler behavior remain within the explicit inherited exclusions.
